Within-subject dependence: Working correlation (exchangeable, independence or AR(1)) as nuisance; robust sandwich variance
Reference distribution: t with N - p df (normal in Table 3)
Typical failure with few clusters / shor: Anticonservative: clearly above 7.5% at 242 main/M1c, 69 M6-M7 and 100 Copula-AR1 design points

Method family: GEE + Mancl-DeRouen (MD) or Fay-Graubard (FG); also Kauermann-Carroll (KC), CR2
Within-subject dependence: As uncorrected GEE; level of FG changed <0.5 points across working correlations
Small-sample device: Leverage-adjusted sandwich: MD (I-H)^-1, KC/CR2 (I-H)^-1/2, FG bounded inflation (b = 0.75)
Reference distribution: t with N - p df (CR2 not with Satterthwaite df)
Typical failure with few clusters / shor: Separated data: plausible estimate, no warning (FG-AR(1) failure, N = 10, T = 2); KC, MD exceed 7.5% often

Target estimand: Conditional (subject-specific); larger than marginal by about (1 + k^2 sigma^2)^1/2
Within-subject dependence: Normal random intercept, random slopes in M3-M5; conditional independence given random effects
Small-sample device: None in main run; adaptive quadrature (10 nodes) examined post hoc, random intercept only
Reference distribution: t with N - p df; LRT against chi-square(1)
Returns: Estimate + Wald CI on conditional scale
Typical failure with few clusters / shor: Laplace anticonservative (515 points above 7.5%); random slope unidentifiable at T = 2; ignores serial dependence

Method family: Marginalized multilevel model (MMLB::mm) with convergence check
Within-subject dependence: Likelihood: latent variable (SD may trend over time) plus first-order transition term
Small-sample device: Check: boundary fit (nlm code not 1/2, or latent-SD slope < 0.001) replaced by converged fit without trend
Typical failure with few clusters / shor: Boundary non-convergence: no result in 16% of M3-M5 fits (32% at T <= 3); conservative at N = 10

Target estimand: No estimate; tests zero marginal interaction via effective score of logistic model without interaction
Within-subject dependence: Subjects treated as independent units; dependence absorbed in per-subject score sums
Small-sample device: Randomization: all sign flips up to 12 subjects, else 1,999 random plus identity
Returns: p-value only; inverted interval often unbounded at T <= 3
Typical failure with few clusters / shor: Not computable when null fit diverges or scores vanish; power 4.2% at T <= 3, N <= 25
